parameters.query: SELECT event_ts_utc AS event_time, machine_id, event_name, event_value FROM DT_EVENT_RAW WHERE machine_id = '{{ $json.machine_id }}' AND parse_status = 'PARSED' AND (UPPER(event_name) LIKE '%ALARM%' OR UPPER(event_name) LIKE '%ERROR%') ORDER BY event_ts_utc DESC FETCH FIRST {{ $json.limit }} ROWS ONLY
